title: Accept a data worktree that the code checkout already ignores, so task-sync data-init stops refusing a correctly ignored .engram-data
outcome: Accept a data worktree that the code checkout already ignores, so task-sync data-init stops refusing a correctly ignored .engram-data
acceptance: `task-sync data-init` succeeds in a checkout whose .gitignore already ignores `.engram-data/` (as git check-ignore reports), with no extra exclude entry, and a regression test with exactly that ignore line fails before the fix and passes after
A data worktree that is genuinely not ignored still refuses, with a message naming the cause and the fix
